'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
***A [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[missile]] strikes a hotel in [[Kryvyi Rih]], Ukraine, killing four people and injuring seven others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-attack-kills-two-injures-seven-ukraines-kryvyi-rih-2025-03-05/ (Reuters)]
**[[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[U.S. Central Intelligence Agency]] [[Director of the Central Intelligence Agency|director]] [[John Ratcliffe]] announces that the [[United States]] has suspended [[intelligence sharing]] with [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/5/us-suspends-intelligence-sharing-with-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***The [[United States]] begins direct negotiations with [[Hamas]] over the release of the remaining [[Gaza war hostage crisis|Israeli hostages]]. [[President of the United States]] [[Donald Trump]] later threatens on [[Truth Social]] and [[Twitter|X]] that the people of Gaza "are dead" unless they return the hostages "immediately". [https://news.sky.com/story/us-holds-talks-with-hamas-13322252 (Sky News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/5/trump-threatens-palestinians-in-gaza-if-you-hold-captives-you-are-dead (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/trump-administration-holding-talks-hamas-release-hostages-rcna194897 (NBC News)]
*[[South Sudanese Civil War]]
**[[2025 Nasir clashes]]
***Security forces in [[South Sudan]] arrest [[Puot Kang Chol]], a senior member of the parliamentary [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|opposition]], [[Ministry of Petroleum and Mining|minister of petroleum and mining]], and [[South Sudan People's Defence Forces|army]] general, as well as multiple other opposition-aligned military officers. South Sudanese soldiers also surround [[Vice President of South Sudan|vice president]] [[Riek Machar]]'s house overnight before later withdrawing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-sudan-detains-oil-minister-several-military-officials-says-vice-presidents-2025-03-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czrnydyy763o (BBC News)]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in the North Caucasus]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Federal Security Service]] says that it killed four [[Islamic State – Caucasus Province|Islamic State]] militants in [[Dagestan]] during a [[counterterrorism]] operation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-say-it-killed-four-islamic-state-affiliated-militants-dagestan-2025-03-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Second Trump tariffs]]
**[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***[[United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a one-month temporary reprieve from [[tariff]]s for [[Automotive industry in the United States|American automakers]] after receiving complaints from the ''[[Big Three (automobile manufacturers)|Big Three]]'': [[Ford Motor Company|Ford]], [[General Motors]], and [[Stellantis]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/03/05/nx-s1-5319094/trump-tariffs-relief-ford-gm-stellantis (NPR)]
*[[2025 United States federal mass layoffs]]
**The [[United States Department of Veteran Affairs]] announces it will [[layoff|lay off]] over 80,000 jobs to comply with the [[second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]'s plans under the [[Department of Government Efficiency]]. [https://apnews.com/article/veterans-affairs-cuts-doge-musk-trump-f587a6bc3db6a460e9c357592e165712 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 Australian region cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Alfred (2025)|Tropical Cyclone Alfred]]
***[[Premier of Queensland|Queensland Premier]] [[David Crisafulli]] announces  the suspension of public transport services and the closure of 640 schools in [[South East Queensland]], [[Australia]], as Cyclone Alfred is expected to make landfall early Friday morning [[UTC+10:00|local time]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-03-05/tropical-cyclone-alfred-brisbane-forecast-queensland-nsw-live/105010498 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[2025 Chugach Mountains avalanche]]
**Three [[Skiing|skiers]] are suspected to be killed after an [[Avalanche|avalanche]] trapped them under more than 30 feet of snow in the [[Chugach Mountains]], [[Alaska]], [[United States]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/alaska-state-troopers-report-multiple-backcountry-skiers-are-trapped-in-an-avalanche-near-anchorage/ (CTV News)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2025/03/05/heli-skiers-killed-alaska-avalanche/81676226007/ (USA Today)]
*One person is killed and sixteen others are injured when a bridge collapses on the E42 highway in [[La Louvière]], [[Hainaut Province]], [[Belgium]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-dead-highway-bridge-collapse-belgium-2025-03-06/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rtbf.be/article/e42-autoroute-fermee-a-houdeng-suite-a-l-affaissement-d-un-pont-11513705 (RTBF)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Somalia–United States relations]]
**The [[Embassy of the United States, Mogadishu|U.S. Embassy]] in [[Mogadishu]] warns of imminent attack threats in [[Somalia]], including at [[Aden Adde International Airport]]. Embassy personnel movements are suspended. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/us-embassy-somalia-issues-urgent-warning-potential-imminent/story?id=119466493 (ABC News)]
**[[Somali National Army|Somali military officials]] confirm that the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] has halted all funding for Somalia's [[Danab Brigade]] [[Special forces|special forces]] and cut billions in [[United States Agency for International Development|USAID]] grants to the country. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Mar/200544/u_s_cuts_funding_for_danab_special_forces_and_other_aid_to_somalia.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of Defense]] denies previous media reports that [[United States Secretary of Defense|Secretary of Defense]] [[Pete Hegseth]] had ordered a halt to offensive cyber operations and information operations against Russia by [[U.S. Cyber Command]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/5177630-pentagon-denies-reports-hegseth-ordered-halt-in-cyber-operations-against-russia/amp/ (''The Hill'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 California wildfires]]
**[[January 2025 Southern California wildfires]]
***In the U.S., [[Los Angeles County]] files a [[lawsuit]] against [[Southern California Edison]], the [[electric utility]] company servicing most of [[Southern California]], and alleges that the company's [[electric power system|power system]] started the [[Eaton Fire]], seeking to recover costs and damages sustained from the fire that damaged over 9,400 buildings and killed 17 people. [https://apnews.com/article/los-angeles-county-eaton-fire-lawsuit-edison-aa9128029619ec833d3c5a04e4c1f673 (AP)] 
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Law enforcement in Mexico|law enforcement]] announces the seizure of 275,000 [[fentanyl]] pills stored in boxes of [[nopal#culinary use|nopales]] in [[Sonora]]. A man is arrested in connection to the seizure. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-cactus-fentanyl-seizure-trump-567088e6ccdee38695e99c9524561e83 (AP)]
**Around 200 pairs of shoes and other personal items are found at [[Jalisco extermination camp|an extermination camp]] in [[Teuchitlán]], Jalisco. [https://www.latintimes.com/cartel-crematorium-found-mexico-authorities-locate-undetermined-amount-burnt-bodies-577837 (''Latin Times'')]
*The [[United States Attorney|U.S. Attorney's Office]] for the [[United States District Court for the District of Vermont|District Court of Vermont]] indicts and charges 25 [[Canada|Canadians]] for [[conspiracy to defraud]] [[Elder financial abuse|elderly people]] in the United States out of US$21 million and charges five of those 25 with [[criminal conspiracy|conspiracy]] to commit [[money laundering]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/03/05/nx-s1-5318821/grandparent-scam-canadians-arrested-vermont (NPR)]
